  "table_summary": "This table reports mean F1 scores (with precision, recall, and accuracy in braces) for 60 experimental configurations combining two CNN architectures (AlexNet, GoogLeNet), two training strategies (transfer learning vs. training from scratch), three input representations (Color, Grayscale, Segmented), and five train/test splits after 30 epochs. GoogLeNet with transfer learning consistently outperforms AlexNet and training from scratch, achieving the best overall mean F1 of 0.9934 with color images at an 80/20 train/test split (precision 0.9935, recall 0.9935, accuracy 0.9935). Color images outperform segmented images, which in turn outperform grayscale; performance improves monotonically as the training set proportion increases, with the weakest result being AlexNet trained from scratch on grayscale with only 20% training data (F1 = 0.8524)."
